description: Hybrid keyword + semantic search over Arca's mirrored public-source corpus: FDA drug labels, Drugs@FDA approvals, complete response letters, warning letters, Orange Book, Purple Book, NDC, drug shortages, device 510(k)/PMA/registrations, MAUDE adverse events, DailyMed, GUDID, postmarket requirements, import refusals, inspections, Form 483s, ClinicalTrials.gov studies, VAERS reports, CDC data, EU expert panel opinions, and BfArM/PMDA device vigilance. Press releases and SEC company filings are searched only when sourceTypes names press_releases or company_filings. Read-only lookup of already-published records: it cannot file, submit, or report anything to FDA, VAERS, MedWatch, or any other agency, so do not call it for requests to file or submit a report. When the question names a record type (warning letters, labels, adverse event reports, trials, recalls), pass the matching sourceTypes rather than searching the whole corpus. Results carry recordId for fetch_source_record and a citable source URL.

anyOf.description: Exact metadata facets share a total budget of 50 values across all arrays. Split larger searches into separate requests.

applicationNumbers.description: Exact drug application, device K or PMA numbers, such as NDA209637, K070051 or P900052.

dateField.description: recordDate uses the source's record date: FDA device decision date, label SPL effective date or trial first submission. postedDate stays separate. Choose a trial milestone, lastUpdateDate or inspectionDate explicitly. Partial dates are excluded, never rounded to a day.

decisionCodes.description: FDA device decision codes, such as SESE or APPR.

deviceClasses.description: FDA device classes as upstream strings, such as 1, 2 or 3.

dins.description: Exact Health Canada eight-digit Drug Identification Numbers, preserving leading zeroes.

inspectionOutcomes.description: FDA inspection classification codes NAI, VAI or OAI.

ndcCodes.description: Exact NDC product codes, preserving leading zeroes and hyphens.

productTypes.description: Upstream product type or category, including FDA import-refusal ProductCategory values such as Foods.

recallClasses.description: Recall classes I, II or III.

recordIds.description: Exact upstream record identifiers, including SPL set/document IDs, trial NCT IDs, device K numbers, PMA supplements such as P900052-S016, PMIDs and substance UNIIs. A trial also lists the PMIDs of its result publications and its EudraCT, CTIS and other registry IDs; a GSRS substance also lists its CAS, DrugBank, ChEMBL and other codes, with numeric ones prefixed by their system, such as RXCUI:1191 or PUBCHEM:2244.

recordTypes.description: 483, EIR, RESPONSE, WARNING LETTER, INSPECTION, IMPORT REFUSAL, RECALL, DRUG LABEL, 510(K) or PMA. Other upstream record types retain their names.

publicSourceFilters.description: Exact metadata filters for FDA enforcement, 510(k)/PMA device decisions, drug labels, FDA guidance, ClinicalTrials.gov studies, Health Canada drug records, EudraGMDP, BfArM/PMDA device notices, FDA complete response letters and EU MDR/IVDR expert-panel opinions. Device record date is the decision date, not receipt. Label record date is SPL effective date. Trial record date is first submission, postedDate is first posting; study milestones and lastUpdateDate are separate. Unknown or partial dates do not match ranges.

query.description: Medical, pharma, clinical, regulatory, device, or safety research query.

sourceTypes.description: Optional source lanes to focus the search (see list_datasets). Omit to search the whole corpus.

name: search_medical

continueInArca.description: Link that opens this question in Arca's research chat on arca.inc, which runs a longer multi-step search and writes a fuller cited answer. Offer it to the user once, at the end of the answer.
